description: This file implements the SessionServerAppManager class, which manages session server applications including launching, preloading, state management, and health checks within a Rialto server environment. It handles communication with session servers, manages their lifecycle, and responds to state changes and pings.

classes.name: SessionServerAppManager
classes.description: Manages session server applications, including launching, preloading, state transitions, and health checks. It interacts with IPC controllers, health check services, and maintains a collection of session server instances.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Launches a session server application with a specified initial state and configuration, returning success status.

methods.name: setSessionServerState
methods.description: Changes the state of a session server identified by app name.

methods.name: onSessionServerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from session servers.

methods.name: sendPingEvents
methods.description: Queues ping events to be sent to all connected session servers.

methods.name: onAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment responses for ping requests.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection info (socket name) for a given app.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels for the session servers and local logging.

methods.name: connectSessionServer
methods.description: Establishes connection to a session server via IPC.

methods.name: configureSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a session server with its parameters via IPC.

methods.name: configurePreloadedSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a preloaded session server for a specific app and state.

methods.name: changeSessionServerState
methods.description: Requests a state change for a session server identified by app name.

methods.name: handleSessionServerStateChange
methods.description: Processes state change events for session servers, handling cleanup and recovery.

methods.name: shutdownAllSessionServers
methods.description: Kills all managed session servers and clears the collection.

methods.name: launchSessionServer
methods.description: Creates and launches a new session server for an app.

methods.name: preloadSessionServer
methods.description: Preloads a new session server instance.

methods.name: getPreloadedServer
methods.description: Returns a preloaded and connected session server if available.

methods.name: getServerByAppName
methods.description: Finds a session server by application name.

methods.name: getServerById
methods.description: Finds a session server by server ID.
